description: Extraction recall for the verifier (task 3.1): the FULL pipeline (verifier/extract.py PDF extraction + normalizer) run over the real RECAP fixtures in manifest.json. Measured 2026-06-14 with pdfplumber 0.11.9, eyecite 2.7.6. test_verifier_recall.py recomputes and checks these: occurrence/distinct counts as FLOORS (an eyecite upgrade finding MORE must not break the suite), key-cite counts and the scanned-zero result exactly. The scanned ECF 21 is the honest negative: an image-only PDF yields zero citations, reported rather than hidden.
